name: Corpse Probe
description: A probe, not a release: F6 turns a corpse freeze on and off. While on, each enemy that dies has its body's physics switched off 3 s after its death; the log has the frame rate every 5 s, to set a fight with it on beside one with it off. Solo or host. The freeze needs Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. Settings in corpse-probe.ini.
